business_problem: Novade brings together the power of man and machine to help construction professionals improve safety, efficiency and productivity. solution_summary: Novade built its Databricks implementation around Databricks SQL, Agent Bricks, Unity Catalog, Databricks Data + AI Platform. Novade brings together the power of man and machine to help construction professionals improve safety, efficiency and productivity. By analyzing construction site data, builders are empowered to make real-time decisions, leveraging field data to predict and prevent issues before they arise.​​. Databricks SQL serves governed analytics, dashboards, and ad hoc queries for business users and operational teams. Agent Bricks provides the agentic and generative AI runtime used to build domain-specific applications. Unity Catalog applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment.
